data.cultural_impact: In Indian culture, the name Bidyut is believed to bestow intelligence, wisdom, and brilliance upon the bearer. It is also associated with the lighting of oil lamps in temples, which symbolizes the illumination of knowledge and truth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, the name Bidyut holds deep spiritual significance as it signifies the inner light of awareness and consciousness within each individual. It also represents the divine light that guides us towards the path of truth and knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bidyut was a king of the Vedic period, who ruled over the kingdom of Anga. The name Bidyut carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Anga was a kingdom in ancient India, located in the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent.
